provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Each candidate forms a spherical nucleus with DeltaG(r)=4*pi*r^2*gamma-(4*pi/3)*r^3*Delta_g_v, where the supplied positive Delta_g_v is the magnitude of bulk free-energy lowering per volume. Infer its positive critical radius and maximum barrier. Independently competing rare-event Poisson rates are proportional to the supplied relative_attempt_rate times exp(-barrier/(kBT)). The unknown common rate multiplier cancels in the identity of the first event.
scope: Conditional homogeneous classical-nucleation comparison, without a real material assignment, heterogeneous substrate, depletion or subsequent growth. Larger bulk lowering alone does not determine which nucleus appears first.
